guide.summary: Linear documents OAuth2 for apps that integrate with Linear, and the read scope covers reading the connected user's account. Use one OAuth authorization per customer account and request only read. Pagination uses first/after with pageInfo.endCursor. Archived issues are excluded by default, so confirm whether they belong in the feature. Issue create and update scopes are excluded. Distribution review for other workspaces is not documented in the supplied sources and remains unknown.

findings.title: Request the read scope for issue title reads
findings.detail: The read scope gives read access to the authorizing user's account and is always present. It is the grant to request for reading issue titles.

evidence.quote: * `read` - (Default) Read access for the user's account. This scope will always be present.

findings.title: The read grant is account-wide, not limited to titles
findings.detail: The documented read scope covers the user's account rather than only issue titles. Do not describe it as a title-only or application-restricted token; verify the granted scope in the authorization response.

evidence.quote: * `read` - (Default) Read access for the user's account. This scope will always be present.

findings.detail: issues:create also allows updating issues and creating attachments, so it must not be requested for this read-only feature.
